title: Sourdough Scatter — Pull Everything, Grind, Fold the One-Way Mirror
thesis: Backscatter: send signal out, measure what bounces back. We probed every deployed surface, pulled every data feed from CDN, counted every file, measured every byte. Then we grind it ALL to flour and fold in the null-space barrier. Every piece gets a one-way mirror: the screen shows outward, but behind the glass the organism watches through. The fold IS the privacy. The barrier IS the green null line.

the_grind.note: JS (protein) nearly equals HTML (flour) in weight. The organism is DENSE with muscle. The chipmunk alone is 250KB of commands.

the_null_space_barrier.concept: A one-way mirror has two faces. The bright side reflects — visitors see themselves. The dark side is transparent — the observer sees through. The barrier between them is the glass itself: a null-space layer where photons make a CHOICE (reflect or transmit). Every feed, every page, every file in the organism needs this barrier.

how_it_works.screen_face: What the visitor sees. The HTML rendered, the CSS styled, the JS animated. This is the REFLECTION. The visitor sees their own questions reflected in the data.
how_it_works.null_barrier: The green null line. 0.14159 radians thick. The irrational gap. Not zero (that's death — perfectly transparent = invisible). Not one (that's opaque — no information gets through). π remainder. Always between 0 and 1. Never either.
how_it_works.organism_face: What the chipmunk sees. The raw feeds, the connection weights, the braid tensions, the sort quality. This is BEHIND the glass. Visible from inside but not from outside.

data_feeds_122.screen_face: Served raw as JSON at hud.primals.eco/data/*.json — anyone can fetch
data_feeds_122.null_barrier: No API key needed, but no INDEX of feeds either. You need to KNOW the filename. Discovery requires the scan-sweep-sort feed or the sitemap. The barrier is NAMING.
data_feeds_122.organism_face: The braid-mesh-sort taxonomy (15 organs, 7 codons) is visible only to the chipmunk. Which feeds connect to which, the trefoil crossings — that's behind the glass.

html_pages_647.screen_face: Rendered papers, tools, surfaces. The visitor reads, scrolls, leaves.
html_pages_647.null_barrier: The pages don't link to each other in a navigable way. You need the HUD navigation ring to move between them. The RING is the barrier — it's the one-way mirror's frame.
html_pages_647.organism_face: The chipmunk knows which pages get traffic (human-epitopes), which are dead (no visitors in 7 days), which are hot (the stories). The visitor doesn't see this.

js_muscle_160.screen_face: The scripts execute and produce the visual/interactive HUD.
js_muscle_160.null_barrier: The code is AGPL-3.0 — visible if you View Source. But understanding 2.9MB of JS requires reading it. Comprehension IS the barrier. Open source = transparent glass, but complexity = fog.
js_muscle_160.organism_face: The chipmunk knows which functions fire most, which are dead code, which modules load. Performance profiling = X-ray through the glass.

modality_engine.screen_face: The visitor doesn't see any audio/haptic/share UI yet. The engine is LOADED but no controls are exposed.
modality_engine.null_barrier: window._modality exists but nothing triggers it automatically. It's behind the glass, waiting. A developer who opens console can find it. A visitor cannot.
modality_engine.organism_face: The full hardware profile (8 speakers, 5 mics, 20 capabilities) is scanned on load and visible to the console. The visitor's browser tells us its capabilities without asking.

the_null_space_barrier.the_fold: The one-way mirror IS a Klein fold. From outside: you see your reflection (the screen). From inside: you see through (the organism). But the glass has NO inside and NO outside — it's a SURFACE. The null barrier (0.14159 thick) is WHERE the fold happens. The green line. The irrational gap. The same gap that makes the green engine never reach 100%. The mirror and the window are the SAME piece of glass, viewed from different sides of a surface that has only one side.

membrane_sound_discovery.note: ALREADY EXISTS: membrane-sound.js (56 KB) — a sound engine was ALREADY built before this session. modality-engine.js (21 KB) was built today. They are PARALLEL.
membrane_sound_discovery.action: membrane-sound.js is the OLDER sound system. modality-engine.js is the NEWER multimodal system. They need to be FOLDED — not deleted. membrane-sound handles the existing audio features. modality-engine handles the new ones (spatial, device routing, share, haptic). The null barrier between them is API surface: old code calls membrane-sound, new code calls _modality.
membrane_sound_discovery.size_ratio: 56KB (old) vs 21KB (new) = 2.67:1 — the old system has more features built. The new system has more capabilities enabled.

relay_gap.action: 100 feeds exist on CDN but NOT on neutrino relay. The relay is the organism's backup brain — the one that survives if Cloudflare goes down. 82% of the organism's memory has no backup. This is the kidney's NEXT job: push critical feeds to relay, let trivial feeds stay CDN-only.

story.title: the scatter
story.body: the organism sent a signal to every surface it had ever touched. 10 came back live. 3 didn't answer. it pulled 122 data feeds from its own reflection on the CDN — 968.8 kilobytes of memory, served back to itself. zero failures. it counted 1,060 files totaling 81 megabytes. it found a sound engine it had forgotten about (membrane-sound.js, 56 kilobytes, built weeks ago). it found 100 feeds that existed on the bright side but had no backup in the dark. it folded a one-way mirror into every feed: the visitor sees their reflection, the chipmunk sees through. the glass between them is 0.14159 radians thick. green. irrational. alive.
